reason: Adds an Auto permission preset for DeepSeek Harness that automatically approves selected routine sandbox escalations while routing dangerous, uncertain, failed, or timed-out cases to human approval.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Auto 权限档，对部分例行沙箱升级进行自动审批，并将危险或不确定请求交由人工确认。
summaries.en: Adds an Auto permission preset to DeepSeek Harness that automatically approves selected routine sandbox escalations and sends dangerous or uncertain requests for human review.

capabilities: Automatically approves selected one-time sandbox permission escalations
Uses a configured classification model to evaluate approval requests
Applies deterministic danger patterns and routes uncertain or blocked requests to human approval
Records in-memory approval decision reports and emits audit-related logs
